description: Table-type: Index IX_N, MoveNext twice, Clone into C; read C's Type, Index, BOF, EOF, ID and Bookmark; C Seek "=" 40 and read NoMatch and ID; C MoveFirst, read P's ID; assign P's Index IX_NDESC and read C's Index and ID. Snapshot: Move 2, Clone, read Type, BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition and ID, C MoveLast, read P's ID, RecordCount of both. Forward-only: MoveNext, Clone, read Type, BOF, EOF and ID. Dynaset with Filter "N > 20" and Sort "N DESC" set before the Clone: Move 1, Clone, read C's Filter, Sort, Type and RecordCount after MoveLast, walk ID; assign P's Filter "N > 50"; read C's Filter; Clone again into C2, read its Filter and walk. Then on the dynaset Clone with the arguments Long 4, Long 2 and Null. Asks the clone's type, inherited properties and starting position per type, which members are shared with the parent, and which types or arguments refuse Clone. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
